name: Shield Capital
identity_check: Confirmed as Shield Capital (shieldcap.com), the early-stage venture firm founded in 2021 by Managing Partners Philip Bilden and Raj Shah (ex-Defense Innovation Unit) that invests in AI, autonomy, cybersecurity and space companies at the convergence of commercial technology and national security. The Fund I release (2023-10-16, datelined San Francisco, CA) matches the lead's $186M figure, and SEC Form D index entries for 'Shield Capital Fund I, L.P.' (San Francisco) and 'Shield Capital Fund II, L.P.' (Burlingame, CA) match the name. Not Shield AI (the defense autonomy company that raises its own rounds) and not Shield Technology Partners; both surfaced in search and are unrelated.

thesis_text.value: Early-stage venture firm backing entrepreneurs whose technology serves both commercial markets and national security, concentrating on four domains: artificial intelligence, autonomy, cybersecurity and space. A team of former founders, investors and national-security officials (including ex-Defense Innovation Unit leaders) positions itself as a long-term partner where commercial technology and defense needs converge.

open_items: Fund II: SEC EDGAR full-text index shows 'Shield Capital Fund II, L.P.' and 'Shield Capital Fund II-Parallel, L.P.' Form D filings (first 2024-07-10, amendments 2025-07-07 and 2026-07-09, Burlingame, CA), but the filing documents on sec.gov were refused for the declared User-Agent, and no press or firm announcement of Fund II's size or close was found. Size and close date left null.
Homepage states 'Assets Under Management $500M+', implying capital beyond Fund I's $186M (Fund II and any other vehicles); the split is not published.
Check size not stated on any page read (firm site, both fund releases, Crunchbase News, Aviation Week teaser).

Stages: the firm says only 'early-stage'; seed and series_a are inferred from the rounds it leads (Watchtower, Autonomous Cyber, UFORCE, Code Metal seeds; SiFly, Star Catcher, Apex Series A). It also co-leads or joins Series B rounds (Starfish Space, Code Metal, TENEX.AI, mPower).
No founder application form or pitch instructions: /contact offers only a general contact form and phone number, so accepts_cold_inbound and application_url are left unknown/omitted.

Nothing found on requiring a US entity or on Indian founders. Portfolio includes Israeli Pillar Security and UFORCE (autonomous systems used in the Russia-Ukraine war), so investing is not strictly US-only, but no policy is stated.

No LinkedIn profile URLs for partners are linked from shieldcap.com; partner focus_sectors are classified from bio fields (Shah: DIU/cyber; Bilden: aerospace & defense, maritime autonomy boards; Brown: DIU/defense acquisition; Serafini: HawkEye 360 space RF, national-security incubation). Principals Akhil Iyer and David Rothzeid and five venture partners are listed without focus areas and were not recorded.

Rounds not recorded: Seasats Axios article (403) so the Seasats round's other investors and stage are unknown; Distributed Spectrum (Shield newsroom post has no funding details); Code Metal $36.5M Series A (Nov 2025, led by Accel) - page does not name Shield; Vannevar Labs $75M (Jan 2023, WSJ link) - Shield page names no round or investors; Knostic, Danti, Obviant, Albedo appear only on database sites and were not confirmed.
Websites and HQ countries for Watchtower Labs, SiFly and Star Catcher not given on the Shield posts; founding years mostly unpublished on the pages read.
Shield Capital's role in Seasats ('Seasats Secures Shield Capital Funding') is recorded as unspecified; whether Shield led is not stated on the page read.
